<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**After months of fighting, Syrian government forces retake control of [[Al-Safa (Syria)|Tulul al-Safa]] in southern Syria from [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]. [https://www.alaraby.co.uk/english/news/2018/11/17/assad-regime-forces-capture-southern-syrian-region-from-is (The New Arab)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] visits victims of the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] and [[Woolsey Fire]] as the death toll rises to 79: 76 in the Camp Fire and three in the Woolsey Fire. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-california-wildfires/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-visit-california-wildfire-zones-after-criticizing-forest-management-n937546 (NBC News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46248510 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Ibrahim Mohamed Solih]] takes the [[oath of office]] and becomes the 7th [[President of the Maldives]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/ibrahim-mohamed-solih-sworn-maldives-president-181117111139762.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Florida gubernatorial election, 2018]]
**[[Florida]] [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] candidate [[Andrew Gillum]] concedes defeat to [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] candidate [[Ron DeSantis]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/florida-governor-race-andrew-gillum-concedes-to-ron-desnatis-today-2018-11-17/ (CBS News)]
*[[Gilets jaunes protests]]
**Hundreds of thousands protest against fuel taxes in France by blocking roadways. One person is killed and more than 200 are injured in subsequent altercations. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/11/17/world/europe/french-drivers-protest-fuel-taxes.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The medical records of [[List of British monarchs|British monarch]] [[George III of the United Kingdom|George III]] are released, solving the mystery of the King's illness, which has plagued historians for hundreds of years. Doctors say he would have been diagnosed with [[bipolar disorder]] had he lived today. [https://people.com/royals/palace-releases-hamilton-king-george-iiis-mental-health-records/ (''People'')]
